{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask].copy()

# Now, compute mean age of customers who converted, excluding missing age (-1)
# Filter for converted = 1 and customer_age != -1
converted_customers = sales_clean[(sales_clean['converted'] == 1) & (sales_clean['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of customers who converted (excluding missing age -1): {mean_age_converted:.2f}")"}
